why: The map of EVERYTHING a player can do for ISK or progression, each with a prior ISK/hr range [low, high] (guesses from common knowledge, replaced by your own timed runs), what unlocks it, and how to test it. `models` shows which are modeled; `next` offers an unmodeled, unlocked one every 4th step and immediately when something new unlocks. Add entries as new features appear. Agency > Agents & Missions read 2026-10-10: 5 career agents are in the Rotonos station; mission agents, epic arcs (9), storyline (none yet), Paragon (cosmetic).

activities.name: AIR career agent missions
activities.how: Take the best open career agent mission (see `next`).

activities.name: Project Discovery
activities.how: Neocom > Business > Project Discovery: classify cell images for about 30 minutes (works docked; the tutorial is done, samples pay about 28,500-30,000 ISK each at 90%+ accuracy).

activities.name: Freelance belt mining (Venture)
activities.how: Mine in your Venture ~45 min (best site: see WHERE), dock, unload the ore into the hangar, then stop. Rotonos has 2 Federation Managed belts with Veldspar, Scordite and Pyroxeres 0-Grade.

activities.name: Hauling mined stock to a better market
activities.how: Haul your stock where `next` / `sellplan` says it pays most.

activities.name: Selling stock into buy orders
activities.how: Sell the stacks `next` lists.

activities.name: Station / hub trading (buy low, sell high)
activities.how: Follow the TRADE step in `next`; confirm prices with `check`.

activities.name: Level 1 security missions (normal agents)
activities.how: Nearest Level 1 security agents: Emens Deroutte, Axiosere (1 jump, Federation Navy); Berwelet Trisevent, Lustre (3 jumps, Sisters of EVE); Annve Hoddoren / Ongunbjer Hetinold, Tourier (5 jumps). Needs a combat-capable ship; time one mission.

activities.name: Level 2 security missions
activities.how: Needs a combat frigate fit; time one mission.

activities.name: Probe-scanning data/relic sites
activities.how: Scan down a data/relic site with probes (see Rounaminck's mission).

activities.name: Salvaging wrecks
activities.how: Salvage wrecks after combat missions with a salvager fitted.
activities.no_test: needs wrecks: only after your own combat missions (combat parked after the 2026-10-21 ship loss); wreck leads on the map still compete

activities.name: Manufacturing T1 items
activities.how: Build a profitable T1 item (see `keep` and `bpbuy`); jobs run in the background.

activities.name: Courier contracts
activities.how: Distribution (courier) agents: L1 Trenck Larcacraine, Agrallarier (7 jumps); L2 Dire Serin, Foves (11), Ivonalle Galelare, Slays (11). Or Contracts > Courier along a route you fly anyway.

activities.name: Loyalty point store flips
activities.how: Spend LP on an item that sells above its ISK+LP cost (see `scan`).

activities.name: Planetary industry (passive)
activities.how: Set up a colony (Buy command center). Rotonos has 8 planets: I and III Barren (I has Carbon Compounds, Microorganisms, Base Metals, Aqueous Liquids, Noble Metals), II/IV/V Gas. Next door: Ligare 9 planets, Waison 7, Tiberis 7, Axiosere. Harvest every few days.

activities.name: T2 invention and manufacturing
activities.how: Turn a T1 blueprint COPY into a T2 one, then build the T2 item. In game: Neocom > Industry (Alt+S) > Blueprints tab > right-click your T1 blueprint copy > Invention; the job window lists the 2 datacore types it needs (buy them on the Market) and the chance of success; click Start (needs a station with a Research/Invention service). Gate: an Encryption Methods skill + the two science skills the datacores name (Caldari: Mechanical + Electronic Engineering).

activities.name: Ratting / belt rats
activities.how: Only in safe space with a proper combat ship; time one hour.

activities.name: Sovereignty colony resources (power/workforce)
activities.blocked: null-sec sovereignty space (nearest 16+ jumps): not routed
activities.how: Not for a new character.

activities.name: Mercenary Dens (Infomorph Decryption Keys)
activities.blocked: Omega clone only, needs a Skyhook on a temperate planet in sov space: not routed
activities.how: Later, if ever.

activities.name: Epic Arc: Visions of Greatness (AIR, 8 chapters)
activities.how: Talk to Cassandra Ahfrim, Manifest V - AIR Laboratories (3 jumps). Chapters: Holographic Reenactment, Caldari Prime Breakout, Travel to the Minmatar, Battle of Pator, Travel to the Amarr... 0 of 8 done. Epic arcs are one-time with big rewards; time each chapter as its own run.

activities.name: Other epic arcs (Blood-Stained Stars 8j, Fractured Legacy 17j, Syndication)
activities.how: Later: pick one after Visions of Greatness; check the route for gank risk first.

activities.name: Storyline missions (standing boosts)
activities.blocked: none assigned yet: they appear after you run many security missions
activities.how: Appear automatically after normal agent missions.

activities.name: Paragon (IRIS) agents: cosmetic personalization items
activities.blocked: cosmetic only (auto-injected, cannot be sold): no ISK value, skipped
activities.how: Ignore for ISK.

activities.name: Mining agents (deliver ore): Level 1
activities.how: Emps Metyt, Axiosere (1 jump, Astral Mining): ore delivery. Others 6 jumps (Arant, Hotak, Tindfjalla).

activities.name: R&D agents (research points and datacores)
activities.blocked: needs standing and R&D skills; nearest 8 jumps: later
activities.how: Later.

activities.name: Locator agents (find player characters)
activities.how: Skipped.

activities.name: Player-vs-player career goals (Duels, PvP, Faction Warfare)
activities.blocked: LATER: needs very high skills and a strong, well-defended and well-armed ship (user, 2026-10-12). Not routed for a new character. Duels are consensual and cost no ship, but need a willing opponent. Re-check when skills and ship allow.
activities.how: Later in the game: AIR Duels / PvP / Faction Warfare goals (each goal 25,000 ISK + 10 career points).

activities.name: Combat Anomalies (Agency > Exploration; visible in the scanner, no probes)
activities.how: Warp to a combat anomaly in a 0.5+ system with a combat-ready ship that passes the 99% rule; time one hour. Same ship and skills as ratting. First open Agency > Exploration to see how many are in THIS system (send me the card), then time one run: loot, salvage and gear you keep are valued at market when you stop the timer.

activities.name: Cosmic Signatures (Agency > Exploration; same as probe scanning)
activities.how: Probe-scan the signature down (see Probe-scanning data/relic sites). First open Agency > Exploration to see how many are in THIS system (send me the card), then time one run: loot, salvage and gear you keep are valued at market when you stop the timer.

activities.name: Escalations (deep-space mystery sites)
activities.blocked: UNAVAILABLE in the Agency for your character (appears after exploring sites): not routed
activities.how: Later.

activities.name: Triglavian Space (Pochven)
activities.blocked: Pochven is low-sec-like space with Triglavian ships: outside the 0.5+ safe rule, not routed
activities.how: Later, if ever.

activities.name: Encounter Surveillance System (ESS banks)
activities.blocked: ESS banks sit in low-sec and null-sec and are fought over by players: outside the 0.5+ safe rule, not routed
activities.how: Later, if ever.

activities.name: Zarzakh (Deathless Circle pirate haven)
activities.blocked: Zarzakh is a dangerous pirate-haven system outside safe space: not routed
activities.how: Later, if ever.

activities.name: Homefront Operations (Agency > Encounters; faction sites in high-sec)
activities.where_seen: 2026-10-20 Agency list: Sirseshin 0.7 (current system, 1 site), Shihuken 0.9 (2 jumps, 12 sites), Waskisen 0.7 (2 jumps, 1 site: Emergency Aid: Convoy), Unpas 0.9 (3 jumps, 2 sites); 30 systems listed
activities.how: Agency > Encounters > Homefront Operations lists sites by system. Example: 'Emergency Aid: Convoy' at Waskisen: Guristas ambushed a repatriation convoy; keep the Charon freighter alive until reinforcements arrive (defence, combat). Needs a combat-ready ship that passes the 99% rule; time one site; loot and rewards are valued at market when you stop.
